en.why_it_matters: Hubert Laws is not merely a veteran name: he is one of the rare artists who made flute a primary modern-jazz voice, and the NEA describes him as a premier musician on the instrument. In Keystone Korner's intimate room, that instantly recognizable, classically grounded but deeply improvisational sound is the event itself. This is the kind of living-master instrumental identity the RADAR should protect even without a promotional anniversary hook.
en.trip_verdict: S. Protect one of the two sets. Worth a dedicated DMV-to-Baltimore drive for living-master instrumental identity and an unusually personal jazz voice. It stays below S+ because the verified context is a regular club engagement rather than a premiere, farewell, reunion or singular historical event.

es.why_it_matters: Hubert Laws no es simplemente un nombre veterano: es uno de los pocos artistas que convirtieron la flauta en una voz principal del jazz moderno, y la NEA lo reconoce como una figura central del instrumento. En la intimidad de Keystone Korner, ese sonido inmediatamente reconocible —con formación clásica pero profundamente improvisatorio— es el acontecimiento mismo. Es exactamente el tipo de identidad instrumental de un maestro vivo que el RADAR debe proteger aunque no exista un gancho promocional de aniversario.
